_comment: Hand-reviewed additions on top of sources/maps/*.json, applied by scripts/build-gateway-catalog.mjs.
entries.<key>: fal, disable (reason), kind/category, param_map / value_transforms (merged; null deletes),
rename, fixed, drop, keep, deny, transforms (appended), transforms_before, replace_transforms,
variants [{when, fal, param_map, fixed, transforms, output}], tier_variant {when, replace:[from,to]},
routing:false (ignore the map's routing), resolve (router-side lookups), output, reviewed (true | [note prefixes]).
extra: entries for studio endpoints that the research maps do not cover.

google-imagen4.reason: fal hosts Imagen 4 only as the preview endpoints, which api.fal.ai/v1/models lists as status=deprecated (re-checked 2026-09-25); no current Imagen 4 endpoint to route to, and another Google model (Nano Banana) is not the same model.

google-imagen4-fast.reason: fal hosts Imagen 4 only as the preview endpoints, which api.fal.ai/v1/models lists as status=deprecated (re-checked 2026-09-25); no current Imagen 4 endpoint to route to, and another Google model (Nano Banana) is not the same model.

google-imagen4-ultra.reason: fal hosts Imagen 4 only as the preview endpoints, which api.fal.ai/v1/models lists as status=deprecated (re-checked 2026-09-25); no current Imagen 4 endpoint to route to, and another Google model (Nano Banana) is not the same model.

veo-4-text-to-video.reason: no Veo 4 on fal (only veo2/veo3/veo3.1); routing Veo 4 requests to the older Veo 3.1 would misstate the model.

veo-4-image-to-video.reason: no Veo 4 on fal (only veo2/veo3/veo3.1); routing Veo 4 requests to the older Veo 3.1 would misstate the model.

ai-video-face-swap.reason: fal has no video face swap; PixVerse Swap (mode person) replaces the whole person and has no face index/gender targeting, so it is not the same tool.

wan2.1-reference-video.reason: Wan VACE 14B reference-to-video without a driving video is undocumented on fal (its task enum is depth|pose|inpainting|outpainting|reframe) and could not be verified without a live call.

perfect-pony-xl.reason: no hosted Perfect Pony XL on fal; fal-ai/lora would need an operator-pinned checkpoint URL (and a licence check) before it can serve these weights.

extra.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro Layers
extra.notes: Layers studio decomposition. fal lists bytedance/seedream/v5/pro/layerize (2-17 transparent PNG layers) and fal-ai/qwen-image-layered, but neither input schema was captured, so the entry stays disabled until one is saved into sources/fal-schemas.json.
